title: Testing irreducibility of subset inverse images over a separably closed extension
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $\Omega/k$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] with $\Omega$ separably closed [def-kun-separably-closed], let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be a scheme morphism [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and let $A\subseteq |X|$ be any subset. If the inverse image of $A$ under $X\times_k\Omega\to X$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is irreducible and nonempty [def-weil-irreducible-components], then for every field $E$ and morphism $z:\operatorname{Spec}E\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, its inverse image under $X\times_k E\to X$ is irreducible and nonempty. No finite type, quasi-compactness, closedness or component hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: For any field K over a separably closed field Ω, the spectrum map Spec K to Spec Ω is geometrically irreducible: the affine pullback isomorphism identifies every field base change with the spectrum of a tensor product of fields, irreducible by lem-weil-pbc-field-tensor-irreducible.

proof.text: For a test field E/k choose a common extension M/k of Ω and E using lem-weil-common-extension-fields. Form X_M as the iterated pullback of X_E. The explicit pullback lift r to X_Ω is a pullback of Spec M to Spec Ω, by pasting and cancellation of pullback squares. Thus r is geometrically irreducible and universally open. Mathlib Scheme.Hom.isIrreducible_preimage makes r inverse image of the supplied irreducible subset irreducible. The identity r followed by the projection to X equals the projection through X_E identifies this with p inverse image of the desired subset. The projection p:X_M to X_E is surjective because the field spectrum map is surjective. Its continuous image is exactly the desired subset by Set.image_preimage_eq, so that subset is irreducible and nonempty.

theorem isIrreducible_preimage_of_isSepClosed_extension {k Ω : Type u}
    [Field k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (A : Set X)
    (hgeom : IsIrreducible
      ((pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k Ω)))) ⁻¹' A)) :
    ∀ (E : Type u) (_ : Field E) (z : Spec (CommRingCat.of E) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)),
      IsIrreducible ((pullback.fst f z) ⁻¹' A)
